 Flames at Ducks projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 15, 2026 
 Link copied 
 FLAMES (9-10-1) at DUCKS (10-9-1) 
 8 p.m. ET; FOXLA+, Prime Video, SN 
 Flames projected lineup 
 Joel Farabee -- Mikael Backlund -- Matt Coronato
 Matvei Gridin -- Martin Pospisil -- Ryan Strome
 Yegor Sharangovich -- Morgan Frost -- Adam Klapka
 William Stromgren -- Jonathan Castagna -- Aydar Suniev
 Yan Kuznetsov -- Zayne Parekh
 Joel Hanley -- Simon Nemec
 Jake Middleton -- Zach Whitecloud 
 Devin Cooley
 Dustin Wolf
 Scratched: Maxim Tsyplakov, Brennan Othmann, Brayden Pachal 
 Injured: Jonathan Huberdeau (hip), Kevin Bahl (lower body) 
 Ducks projected lineup 
 Cutter Gauthier -- Leo Carlsson -- Judd Caulfield
 Beckett Sennecke -- Mikael Granlund -- Troy Terry
 Jeff Malott -- Tim Washe -- Sam Colangelo
 Nikita Nesterenko -- Roger McQueen -- Alex Killorn
 Jackson LaCombe -- Drew Helleson
 Tyson Hinds -- Tristan Luneau
 Pavel Mintyukov -- Noah Warren
 Ville Husso
 Lukas Dostal
 Scratched: Travis Mitchell, Frank Vatrano 
 Injured: A.J. Greer (upper body), Ian Moore (lower body), Ryan Poehling (MCL) 
 Status report  
 Neither team held a morning skate. ... Cooley is expected to start after Wolf made 29 saves in a 3-2 win at the Los Angeles Kings on Saturday. ... Husso is expected to start after Dostal made 19 saves in a 6-2 loss to the visiting New York Islanders on Saturday. ... Ducks coach Joel Quenneville said on Wednesday that Moore "could be playing by the end of the week." The defenseman was injured on the first day of training camp.
